# Bundled model

The container includes **SmolLM2-135M-Instruct**, published by HuggingFaceTB (Hugging Face Smol Models Research), under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

- Source: https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct
- Model and tokenizer revision: `12fd25f77366fa6b3b4b768ec3050bf629380bac`
- License: `SmolLM2-LICENSE.txt` in this directory
- The original checkpoint and tokenizer files are bundled without modification. Runtime inference loads the weights in float32.

The upstream model card is also retained in the bundled Hugging Face snapshot under `/opt/model-cache` in the image. This notice describes the bundled model; it does not assign a license to the JMAC project.
